title: Provider worktree placement: support a main checkout created with git init --separate-git-dir
outcome: A test command whose explicit cwd is a main checkout created with `git init --separate-git-dir` (its `.git` is a pointer file to the common directory, not to `worktrees/<name>`) is recognised as a worktree of the session's repository for provider placement and artifact association, the same way a main checkout with a `.git` directory is.
acceptance: From a session in a linked worktree, a test command whose explicit cwd is a main checkout with a `.git` pointer to the session repository's common directory keeps its provider, registration, artifact and native-completion association. Shown by a behavioural test.
A `.git` pointer to a directory that is not the session repository's common directory is still refused. Shown by a behavioural test.
The review pair has no outstanding Medium-or-higher finding, and the full gate passes on the exact landed input.
